label: v_note titles (length + hex-safe)
sql: SELECT slug, length(title) AS title_chars, length(CAST(title AS BLOB)) AS title_bytes, substr(title,1,60) AS head, inbound, outbound, pagerank FROM v_note ORDER BY slug

label: SELECT * FROM v_note (raw, adversarial titles)
sql: SELECT * FROM v_note ORDER BY slug

label: v_link all
sql: SELECT src, dst, substr(src_title,1,40), substr(dst_title,1,40) FROM v_link ORDER BY src,dst

label: v_dangling with pipe-titled citer
sql: SELECT target, citing_notes, cited_by FROM v_dangling ORDER BY target

label: self link in v_note
sql: SELECT slug, inbound, outbound FROM v_note WHERE slug='selfie'

label: dup edge: hub->dup-target rows in v_link
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_link WHERE src='hub' AND dst='dup-target'

label: dup-target inbound
sql: SELECT slug, inbound FROM v_note WHERE slug='dup-target'

label: raw edge vs dangling_link counts
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edge) AS edges, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dangling_link) AS dl

label: longy title in v_note title cell
sql: SELECT title FROM v_note WHERE slug='longy'

label: pagerank nulls adversarial
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(pagerank IS NULL) AS null_pr, SUM(betweenness IS NULL) AS null_bt FROM v_note
